scenes.say: Formula Two races on the same weekends and the same tracks as Formula One. But it's a very different game.
Everyone drives the same Dallara chassis. The driver makes the difference, not the factory.
A three point four litre turbo V6 with about six hundred twenty horsepower. Formula One has around a thousand.
Saturday is the sprint, and the top ten from qualifying start in reverse. The fastest starts tenth.
Sunday is the feature race. At least one pit stop and both tyre compounds are mandatory.
A feature win pays twenty-five points, a sprint win ten. Qatar and Abu Dhabi will decide the title.
Formula Two standings are on LapRadar.
